headword: {基本料金|きほんりょうきん}
gloss: basic fee; base charge; basic rate

definitions.gloss: basic fee; base charge; basic rate
definitions.explanation: A fixed fee charged as the minimum or starting amount for a service, before any additional usage charges are added.

examples.japanese: タクシーの{基本料金|きほんりょうきん}はいくらですか。
examples.english: How much is the basic fare for a taxi?

examples.japanese: {携帯|けいたい}の{基本料金|きほんりょうきん}が{値上|ねあ}がりした。
examples.english: The basic charge for my mobile phone went up.

examples.japanese: {電気|でんき}の{基本料金|きほんりょうきん}は{使用量|しようりょう}に{関係|かんけい}なく{毎月|まいつき}{一定額|いっていがく}がかかる。
examples.english: The basic electricity charge is a fixed amount every month regardless of usage.

notes:
A practical compound frequently encountered in daily life in Japan, especially when dealing with utilities, taxis, phone plans, and other services. Composed of {基本|きほん} (basic, fundamental) and {料金|りょうきん} (fee, charge).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {基本料金|きほんりょうきん}が{含|ふく}まれる: the basic fee is included
- {基本料金|きほんりょうきん}{無料|むりょう}: no basic fee
- {基本料金|きほんりょうきん}+{従量制|じゅうりょうせい}: basic fee plus usage-based pricing
- {基本料金|きほんりょうきん}の{見直|みなお}し: review of the basic rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {初乗|はつの}り{料金|りょうきん}: initial fare (taxis) — the starting fare for the first distance
- {定額|ていがく}{料金|りょうきん}: flat-rate fee — a fixed fee regardless of usage
- {手数料|てすうりょう}: handling fee / commission — a fee for processing or service

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, utility bills ({電気|でんき}・ガス・{水道|すいどう}) and mobile phone plans commonly have a {基本料金|きほんりょうきん} component. Recent deregulation of the electricity market has led to more competition on basic rates.
